entities.summary: Euronext Amsterdam is a stock exchange based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Formerly known as the Amsterdam Stock Exchange, it merged on 22 September 2000 with the Brussels Stock Exchange and the Paris Stock Exchange to form Euronext. The registered office of Euronext, itself incorporated in the Netherlands a public limited company, is also located in the exchange. Amsterdam Stock Exchange is a stock exchange in Beursplein 5, Amsterdam, established in 1700. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
